[RDSC.9.4] **A loader skips, by name, the atoms a runtime does not consume.**
Every atom a loader meets is in its series' registry ([RDSC.7.1],
[LDET.1.10]). A loader **must** step over the frame of each of these, log at
info level (category `dsc-load`, naming the atom and its byte offset), and load
the rest of the artefact as it would without it: the test and oracle atoms
([RDSC.7.6]), `DocString` ([RDSC.14.4.4]) and `CompiledCode` ([RDSC.4c.3]). An atom in a container its container-legality
does not admit is refused ([RFCS.17.3]).
